source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice short questions written from Chapter 24 (PDF 118-133), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 24 (Organic Nitrogen Compounds) ke poore chapter se practice short questions (mukhtasar sawal) hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein, Board ke 2 number wale sawal ke andaz mein. Har sawal ka mukhtasar model jawab hai; chhote numericals mein hal ke qadam hain, aur farq wale sawal ka jawab table mein hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 Give any four uses or occurrences of organic nitrogen compounds mentioned in the chapter.
(Chapter mein bayan kiye gaye organic nitrogen compounds ke koi chaar istemal ya maujoodgi likhein.)
blocks.explanation: (1) Amino acids aur nucleotides, jin se proteins bante hain, zindagi ki bunyaad. (2) Amines aur nitro compounds dye industry aur dawaon mein. (3) Nitrogen wale polymers: nylon, Kevlar® aur polyurethane. (4) Khurak, fertilisers (khaad) aur explosives (dhamaka-khez maadde).

book_ref.quote: Amines and nitro compounds have the pivotal significance in the dye industry and medicines

blocks.prompt:
2 Why are amines called organic derivatives of ammonia? Give the IUPAC general name of amines.
(Amines ko ammonia ke organic derivatives kyun kehte hain? Amines ka IUPAC aam naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Amines mein alkyl ya aryl groups ammonia (NH₃) ke aik, do ya teen hydrogen atoms ki jagah le lete hain, is liye yeh ammonia ke organic derivatives (makhooz) hain. IUPAC nizaam mein inhein alkanamines kehte hain, maslan methanamine CH₃NH₂.

book_ref.quote: Amines are considered as organic derivatives of ammonia

blocks.prompt:
3 What is a quaternary ammonium salt? Give one example.
(Quaternary ammonium salt kya hai? Aik misaal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Woh nitrogen derivative jis mein positive charge wale nitrogen se chaar alkyl ya aryl groups jure hon, quaternary ammonium salt kehlata hai. Misaal: tetramethylammonium chloride, (CH₃)₄N⁺Cl⁻.

book_ref.quote: Tetra-substituted nitrogen derivatives are also known, and are termed as quaternary ammonium salts

blocks.prompt:
4 How does the classification of amines into primary, secondary and tertiary differ from that of alcohols?
(Amines ki primary, secondary aur tertiary mein taqseem alcohols se kaise mukhtalif hai?)
blocks.explanation: Amines mein nitrogen atom par branching (N par carbon groups ki tadaad) class tay karti hai. Alcohols aur monohaloalkanes mein class us carbon atom se tay hoti hai jis par functional group laga ho, yani us carbon se kitne carbons jure hain.

book_ref.quote: This is not the same as in the case of the alcohols or monohaloalkanes

rows: Class nitrogen atom par branching se tay hoti hai
Class –OH ya –X wale carbon atom par branching se tay hoti hai
N par carbon groups gine jate hain
C–OH ya C–X wale carbon par carbon atoms gine jate hain

blocks.prompt:
5 Write the structural formulas of N-methylmethanamine and N-methylethanamine. How many H atoms does their nitrogen carry?
(N-methylmethanamine aur N-methylethanamine ke structural formulas likhein. In ke nitrogen par kitne H atoms hain?)
blocks.explanation:
N-methylmethanamine: CH₃–NH–CH₃
N-methylethanamine: CH₃–NH–CH₂–CH₃
Dono secondary amines hain; nitrogen par do carbon groups aur sirf aik H atom hai (–NH–).

book_ref.quote: In secondary amines, two alky or aryl groups are attached to NH group

blocks.prompt:
6 Name and give the formula of one aliphatic and one aromatic tertiary amine from the chapter.
(Chapter se aik aliphatic aur aik aromatic tertiary amine ka naam aur formula likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Aliphatic: N,N-dimethylmethanamine (trimethylamine), (CH₃)₃N.
Aromatic: triphenylamine, (C₆H₅)₃N.
Dono mein teen alkyl ya aryl groups aik hi nitrogen atom se jure hain.

book_ref.quote: Tertiary amines: N,N-dimethylmethanamine and triphenylamine

blocks.prompt:
7 How does the ratio of ammonia to halogenoalkane decide the major amine formed?
(Ammonia aur halogenoalkane ki nisbat bara amine product kaise tay karti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Agar NH₃ zyada ho to bara product primary amine hota hai (is liye zyada ethanolic ammonia pressure ke saath li jati hai). Agar halogenoalkane zyada ho to bani hui amine aage react karti hai aur bara product tertiary amine hota hai.

book_ref.quote: If NH₃ is in excess, the major product will be primary amine

blocks.prompt:
8 Write the equation for the preparation of ethanamine from bromoethane. State the conditions.
(Bromoethane se ethanamine banane ki equation likhein. Conditions bhi likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
CH₃CH₂Br + NH₃ (zyada) → CH₃CH₂NH₂ + HBr
Conditions: zyada ethanolic ammonia, ethanol mein, high pressure par (nucleophilic substitution).

book_ref.quote: Bromoethane and excess ammonia give ethanamine

blocks.prompt:
9 How is propan-1-amine prepared from propanenitrile? Give the equation.
(Propanenitrile se propan-1-amine kaise banai jati hai? Equation dein.)
blocks.explanation:
Propanenitrile ko LiAlH₄ (ya H₂/Ni) se reduce kiya jata hai:
CH₃CH₂C≡N + 4[H] → CH₃CH₂CH₂NH₂ (propan-1-amine)

book_ref.quote: Reduction of propanenitrile to propan-1-amine

blocks.prompt:
10 Write a balanced equation for the reduction of nitroethane with LiAlH₄.
(Nitroethane ki LiAlH₄ se reduction ki balanced equation likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
CH₃CH₂NO₂ + 3H₂ —(LiAlH₄)→ CH₃CH₂NH₂ + 2H₂O
Nitroalkanes LiAlH₄ se primary amines ban jate hain; nitroethane se ethanamine banti hai.

book_ref.quote: Reduction of nitroethane to ethanamine

blocks.prompt:
11 Why does the reduction of alkanamides by LiAlH₄ give primary amines in good yield?
(Alkanamides ki LiAlH₄ se reduction primary amines achhi yield mein kyun deti hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Kyun ke is reaction mein koi byproduct (koi aur amine) nahi banta:
CH₃CONH₂ + 4[H] —(LiAlH₄)→ CH₃CH₂NH₂ + H₂O

book_ref.quote: Alkanamides are reduced by LiAlH₄ to form primary amines in good yield

blocks.prompt:
12 What is special about the amine obtained in the Hofmann reaction? Write the equation for ethanamide.
(Hofmann reaction se milne wali amine mein khaas baat kya hai? Ethanamide ki equation likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Hofmann reaction shuru wali amide se aik carbon kam wali amine deta hai:
CH₃CONH₂ + Br₂ + 4NaOH → CH₃NH₂ + 2NaBr + Na₂CO₃ + 2H₂O
Ethanamide (2 C) se methanamine (1 C) banti hai.

book_ref.quote: This reaction yields the amine with one carbon less than the starting amide.

blocks.prompt:
13 How is N-methylethanamine obtained by alkylation? Give the equation.
(Alkylation se N-methylethanamine kaise hasil hoti hai? Equation dein.)
blocks.explanation:
Primary amine (methanamine) ko halogenoalkane (bromoethane) ke saath ethanol mein pressure par react karaya jata hai:
CH₃CH₂Br + CH₃NH₂ → CH₃CH₂NHCH₃ + HBr

book_ref.quote: When a halogenolkane reacts with a primary amine in the presence of ethanol under pressure

blocks.prompt:
14 Which amine is formed by the reduction of N-methylethanamide? Give the balanced equation.
(N-methylethanamide ki reduction se kaun si amine banti hai? Balanced equation dein.)
blocks.explanation:
Secondary amine, N-methylethanamine:
CH₃CONHCH₃ + 2H₂ → CH₃CH₂NHCH₃ + H₂O
C=O CH₂ ban jata hai aur us ki oxygen paani ban kar nikalti hai.

book_ref.quote: CH₃CONHCH₃ + 2H₂ → CH₃CH₂NHCH₃ + H₂O

blocks.prompt:
15 What is ammonolysis? Give its use in preparing phenylamine.
(Ammonolysis kya hai? Phenylamine banane mein is ka istemal batayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Ammonolysis woh reaction hai jis mein ammonia ka molecule toot kar kisi aur compound se react karta hai. Chlorobenzene ki ammonolysis (Cu₂O, 250 °C, 50 atm):
C₆H₅Cl + 2NH₃ → C₆H₅NH₂ + NH₄Cl

book_ref.quote: Ammonylsis is a reaction in which an ammonia molecule is broken down

blocks.prompt:
16 Write the Hofmann reaction that gives phenylamine.
(Phenylamine dene wala Hofmann reaction likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Benzamide ko bromine aur sodium hydroxide ke saath react karaya jata hai; aik carbon carbonate ban kar nikal jata hai:
C₆H₅CONH₂ + Br₂ + 4NaOH → C₆H₅NH₂ + 2NaBr + Na₂CO₃ + 2H₂O

book_ref.quote: Hofmann reaction of benzamide

blocks.prompt:
17 Why does an aqueous solution of ethanamine turn red litmus blue? Give the equation.
(Ethanamine ka paani wala mehlool surkh litmus ko neela kyun karta hai? Equation dein.)
blocks.explanation:
Ammonia ki tarah ethanamine paani se juzwi react kar ke OH⁻ ions banati hai, is liye mehlool halka alkaline hota hai:
CH₃CH₂NH₂ + H₂O ⇌ CH₃CH₂NH₃⁺ + OH⁻

book_ref.quote: The amines which are soluble in water form weakly alkine solutions

blocks.prompt:
18 How do electron-donating and electron-withdrawing groups affect the basicity of amines?
(Electron dene wale aur electron khenchne wale groups amines ki basicity par kya asar dalte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Basicity nitrogen ke lone pair ki dastyabi par munhasir hai. Electron dene wale alkyl groups N ki taraf electrons dhakelte hain aur basicity barhate hain; electron khenchne wale groups electrons door karte hain aur basicity kam karte hain.

book_ref.quote: It is clear that electron-donating alkyl groups attached to the nitrogen atom increase the basicity

blocks.prompt:
19 Why is ethanamine a stronger base than ammonia? Support with pKb values.
(Ethanamine ammonia se taqatwar base kyun hai? pKb values se sabit karein.)
blocks.explanation: Electron dene wala ethyl group nitrogen par electron density (lone pair ki dastyabi) barhata hai. pKb: ethanamine 3.29 < ammonia 4.75; chhota pKb taqatwar base ki nishani hai.

book_ref.quote: Etahanamine is a stronger base than ammonia and methanamine

blocks.prompt:
20 Explain with reference to Figure 24.1 why phenylamine is a weaker base than ammonia.
(Figure 24.1 ke hawale se samjhayein ke phenylamine ammonia se kamzor base kyun hai.)
blocks.explanation: Phenylamine mein nitrogen planar hai aur lone pair p orbital mein hai. Yeh benzene ring ke delocalised π electrons se overlap karta hai, is liye lone pair phail jata hai aur proton lene ke liye kam dastyab hota hai (pKb 9.38 bamuqabla ammonia 4.75).

book_ref.quote: The nitrogen atom is planar, with its lone pair in a p orbital

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Lone pair jitna 'azad' hoga, base utni taqatwar hogi. Ethyl group lone pair ko aur 'bhara' bana deta hai (taqatwar base), jab ke benzene ring lone pair ko apne andar khench kar phaila deti hai (kamzor base). Is liye tarteeb: ethanamine > ammonia > phenylamine.

blocks.prompt:
21 An amine has Kb = 6.3 × 10⁻⁵. Taking pKb = –log Kb, find its pKb and say whether it is stronger or weaker than ammonia (pKb 4.75).
(Aik amine ka Kb = 6.3 × 10⁻⁵ hai. pKb = –log Kb le kar is ka pKb nikalein aur batayein ke yeh ammonia (pKb 4.75) se taqatwar hai ya kamzor.)
blocks.explanation:
pKb = –log(6.3 × 10⁻⁵) = 4.20
4.20 < 4.75, is liye yeh amine ammonia se taqatwar base hai (chhota pKb, bara Kb).

book_ref.quote: Its own Table 24.1 gives ethanamine pKb = 3.29 (Kb = 5.1 × 10⁻⁴)

blocks.prompt:
22 Using the Kb values in Table 24.1, how many times stronger a base is ammonia than phenylamine?
(Table 24.1 ki Kb values se ammonia phenylamine se kitne guna taqatwar base hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Nisbat = Kb(NH₃) ÷ Kb(C₆H₅NH₂) = 1.8 × 10⁻⁵ ÷ 4.2 × 10⁻¹⁰ = 4.3 × 10⁴
Ammonia taqriban 43 000 guna taqatwar base hai.

book_ref.quote: Table 24.1 The basicity of some amines

blocks.prompt:
23 How do amines form salts with acids? Give one equation.
(Amines acids ke saath salts kaise banati hain? Aik equation dein.)
blocks.explanation:
Basic hone ki wajah se nitrogen apna lone pair acid ke proton ko deta hai, dative bond banta hai aur ammonium jaisa salt banta hai:
CH₃CH₂NH₂ + HCl → CH₃CH₂NH₃⁺Cl⁻

book_ref.quote: In this reaction, the nitrogen atom donates an electron pair to form a dative bond with a proton

blocks.prompt:
24 Why is the smell of fish reduced by lemon juice or vinegar?
(Machhli ki boo lemon juice ya sirke se kam kyun ho jati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Badboo base N,N-dimethylmethanamine (trimethylamine), (CH₃)₃N, ki wajah se hai. Lemon juice ka acid (citric acid) ya sirka is amine se react kar ke salt banata hai, is liye boo kam ho jati hai.

book_ref.quote: When lemon juice is sprinkled on fish its acid (citric acid) reacts with the amine making it less smelly

blocks.text: 24.3.2 Distinction between Primary and Secondary Amines

blocks.prompt:
25 What is diazotization? Give the equation for ethanamine.
(Diazotization kya hai? Ethanamine ki equation dein.)
blocks.explanation:
Primary amine ka nitrous acid se react kar ke diazonium salt banana diazotization hai (HNO₂, NaNO₂ + HCl se):
CH₃CH₂NH₂ + HNO₂ + HCl → CH₃CH₂N₂⁺Cl⁻ + 2H₂O

book_ref.quote: Primary amines react with nitrous acid to form diazonium salts

blocks.prompt:
26 Write the reaction of N-methylethanamine with nitrous acid. What is observed?
(N-methylethanamine ka nitrous acid se reaction likhein. Kya nazar aata hai?)
blocks.explanation:
CH₃CH₂NHCH₃ + HNO₂ → CH₃CH₂N(NO)CH₃ + H₂O
N-nitrosoamine (N-methyl-N-nitrosoethanamine) peele tel jaise maaye ki shakal mein alag ho jata hai.

book_ref.quote: Secondary amines form N-nitrosoamines (yellow oily liquid) on reaction with nitrous acid

blocks.prompt:
27 Why does a tertiary amine show no visible change with nitrous acid?
(Tertiary amine nitrous acid ke saath koi nazar aane wali tabdeeli kyun nahi dikhati?)
blocks.explanation:
Tertiary amine sirf hal hone wala nitrite salt banati hai, maslan
(CH₃)₂NCH₂CH₃ + HNO₂ → (CH₃)₂NHCH₂CH₃⁺ NO₂⁻
Na gas banti hai na tel ki tah, is liye reaction ki koi nishani nazar nahi aati.

book_ref.quote: Tertiary amines react with nitrous acid to form soluble nitrite salts

blocks.prompt:
28 Distinguish between a primary and a secondary aliphatic amine by the nitrous acid test.
(Nitrous acid test se primary aur secondary aliphatic amine mein farq batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Har amine mein nitrous acid (NaNO₂ + HCl) dalein aur dekhein:

book_ref.quote: Secondary amines react with nitrous acid to produce yellow oily liquid.

rows: Diazonium salt banta hai (diazotization)
N-nitrosoamine banta hai
Nitrogen gas nikalti hai (bulbulay)
Peela tel jaisa maaya alag hota hai
maslan ethanamine
maslan N-methylethanamine

blocks.prompt:
29 What is the hybridisation of the nitrogen atom in phenylamine? Justify.
(Phenylamine mein nitrogen atom ki hybridisation kya hai? Wajah batayein.)
blocks.explanation: sp². Nitrogen planar hai aur us ka lone pair p orbital mein hai jo benzene ring ke π electrons se overlap karta hai (Figure 24.1); planar atom jis ka lone pair p orbital mein ho sp² hota hai, ring ke carbons ki tarah.

book_ref.quote: Hybridisation in phenylamine: sp2 ring carbons and the nitrogen atom

blocks.prompt:
30 Why does phenylamine give a tribromo product with bromine water? Write the equation.
(Phenylamine bromine water ke saath tribromo product kyun deti hai? Equation likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
–NH₂ ortho-para directing hai aur ring ko kaafi reactive banata hai, is liye dono ortho aur para positions aik hi reaction mein brominate ho jati hain:
C₆H₅NH₂ + 3Br₂ → C₆H₂Br₃NH₂ (2,4,6-tribromophenylamine, safaid ppt) + 3HBr

book_ref.quote: its two ortho and the para positions, all are occupied in a single reaction

blocks.prompt:
31 Why is nitrous acid prepared in situ for diazotization? Give the equation.
(Diazotization ke liye nitrous acid mauqa par (in situ) kyun banaya jata hai? Equation dein.)
blocks.explanation:
Nitrous acid ghair-mustaqil hai, is liye ise reaction mixture hi mein sodium nitrite aur HCl se banaya jata hai:
NaNO₂ + HCl → HNO₂ + NaCl

book_ref.quote: Nitrous acid is unstable and is prepared in situ

blocks.prompt:
32 Why is the diazotization of phenylamine carried out below 10 °C?
(Phenylamine ki diazotization 10 °C se kam par kyun ki jati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Diazonium salts ghair-mustaqil hain; zyada temperature par, room temperature par bhi, yeh aasani se toot kar nitrogen gas, N₂, chhorte hain. Barf mixture ko 10 °C se kam rakhti hai taa ke phenyldiazonium salt bacha rahe.

book_ref.quote: This is because the diazonium salts are unstable and will decompose easily

blocks.prompt:
33 Convert phenylamine into phenol. Give equations.
(Phenylamine ko phenol mein badlein. Equations dein.)
blocks.explanation:
(1) 10 °C se kam par diazotization: C₆H₅NH₂ + HNO₂ + HCl → C₆H₅N₂⁺Cl⁻ + 2H₂O
(2) Paani ke saath garam karein: C₆H₅N₂⁺Cl⁻ + H₂O → C₆H₅OH + N₂ + HCl

book_ref.quote: Diazotisation of phenylamine and hydrolysis of phenyldiazonium chloride to phenol

blocks.prompt:
34 Why are aryl diazonium salts more stable than alkyl diazonium salts?
(Aryl diazonium salts alkyl diazonium salts se zyada mustaqil kyun hain?)
blocks.explanation: Aryl diazonium ions mein positive charge aromatic ring par phail jata hai jis se izafi mustaqili milti hai; yeh kam temperature par kaafi mustaqil hain. Alkyl diazonium salts mein aisa phailao nahi, yeh har haal mein bohat ghair-mustaqil hain aur alag nahi kiye ja sakte.

book_ref.quote: The aryl diazonium salts are however fairly stable at low temperatures

blocks.prompt:
35 Differentiate between a diazo compound and an azo compound.
(Diazo compound aur azo compound mein farq batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono ka farq un ke nitrogen group mein hai:

book_ref.quote: The organic compounds having diazonium ion, –N⁺≡N (diazo group) as a functional group are called diazo compounds

rows: Functional group: diazonium ion –N⁺≡N
Is mein azo bond –N=N– hota hai
Primary amine ki diazotization se banta hai
Diazonium salt ki phenol ya amine se coupling se banta hai
maslan benzenediazonium chloride
maslan p-hydroxyazobenzene

blocks.prompt:
36 What is a coupling reaction? Give one example.
(Coupling reaction kya hai? Aik misaal dein.)
blocks.explanation:
Aryl diazonium salt ka taqatwar activated aromatic compound (phenol ya amine) se reaction jis se –N=N– wala azo compound banta hai. Misaal (halka NaOH):
C₆H₅N₂⁺Cl⁻ + C₆H₅OH → C₆H₅–N=N–C₆H₄–OH (p-hydroxyazobenzene, narangi solid) + HCl

book_ref.quote: The reactions of aryl diazonium salts with strongly activated aromatic compounds

blocks.prompt:
37 What role does the diazonium ion play in coupling with phenol, and where does it attack?
(Phenol ke saath coupling mein diazonium ion kya kirdaar ada karta hai aur kahan hamla karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Positive charge wala diazonium ion electrophile hai. Yeh phenol ki benzene ring mein para position par substitute hota hai; phir intermediate H⁺ kho kar azo compound banata hai.

book_ref.quote: In the coupling reaction, the positively charged diazonium ion acts as an electrophile

blocks.prompt:
38 State the conditions for coupling of a diazonium salt with (i) phenol (ii) an aromatic amine.
(Diazonium salt ki coupling ki conditions likhein: (i) phenol ke saath (ii) aromatic amine ke saath.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Phenol ke saath: halka alkaline mehlool (dilute NaOH).
(ii) Aromatic amine ke saath: halki acidic conditions (maslan ethanoic acid, jaise butter yellow aur methyl orange banane mein).

book_ref.quote: Coupling with phenol occurs in mild alkaline solution

blocks.prompt:
39 What is butter yellow? Why is it no longer used in food?
(Butter yellow kya hai? Ab ise khane mein kyun istemal nahi kiya jata?)
blocks.explanation: Butter yellow azo dye p-dimethylaminoazobenzene hai, jo benzenediazonium chloride ki N,N-dimethylphenylamine se coupling se banta hai. Pehle khane mein istemal hota tha, magar carcinogenic (cancer paida karne wala) hone ki wajah se ab mamnoo hai.

book_ref.quote: However, due to its carcinogenic nature, its use in food is now forbidden

blocks.prompt:
40 How is methyl orange prepared? What is its use?
(Methyl orange kaise banta hai? Is ka istemal kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Methyl orange diazotized sulfanilic acid (sodium salt, NaO₃S–C₆H₄–N₂⁺Cl⁻) ki N,N-dimethylphenylamine ke saath ethanoic acid mein coupling se banta hai; product mein azo group N=N hota hai. Yeh acid-base indicator ke taur par istemal hota hai.

book_ref.quote: Methyl orange is an acid-base indicator and is prepared from diazotized sulfanilic acid

blocks.prompt:
41 What are azo dyes? Name two azo dyes from the chapter.
(Azo dyes kya hain? Chapter se do azo dyes ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Azo dyes rangeen compounds hain jo phenylamine ke diazonium salt aur activated benzene ring wale aryl compound ke reaction se bante hain. Misalein: butter yellow (p-dimethylaminoazobenzene) aur methyl orange. Food colours mein aksar azo dyes hote hain.

book_ref.quote: Azo dyes are the coloured compounds which are prepared by the reaction of diazonium salt of phenylamine

blocks.prompt:
42 What are alkanenitriles? Name the compound CH₃CH₂CN.
(Alkanenitriles kya hain? CH₃CH₂CN ka naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: –CN functional group wale organic compounds alkanenitriles hain, maslan ethanenitrile CH₃–CN. CH₃CH₂CN propanenitrile hai. In ka sab se ahem istemal dilute acid ya dilute alkali se hydrolysis kar ke carboxylic acids banana hai.

book_ref.quote: Hydrolysis of nitriles can occur with both dilute acid and dilute alkali

blocks.prompt:
43 Write the equation for the acid hydrolysis of ethanenitrile with dilute HCl.
(Ethanenitrile ki dilute HCl ke saath acid hydrolysis ki equation likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Dilute hydrochloric acid ke saath garam karne par carboxylic acid banta hai:
CH₃CN(aq) + 2H₂O(l) + HCl(aq) → CH₃COOH(aq) + NH₄Cl(aq)

book_ref.quote: When a nitrile is heated with a dilute acid

blocks.prompt:
44 How is ethanoic acid obtained from ethanenitrile by alkaline hydrolysis? Give equations.
(Alkaline hydrolysis se ethanenitrile se ethanoic acid kaise hasil hota hai? Equations dein.)
blocks.explanation:
Dilute NaOH ke saath garam kar ke sodium salt banayein, phir dilute HCl se acidify karein:
CH₃CN(aq) + H₂O(l) + NaOH(aq) → CH₃COONa(aq) + NH₃(g)
CH₃COONa(aq) + HCl(aq) → CH₃COOH(aq) + NaCl(aq)

book_ref.quote: a salt of carboxylic acid is produced, which on acidification

blocks.prompt:
45 Differentiate between the acid and the alkaline hydrolysis of ethanenitrile.
(Ethanenitrile ki acid aur alkaline hydrolysis mein farq batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono –CN ko carboxylic acid mein badalti hain, magar products mukhtalif hain:

book_ref.quote: When a nitrile is heated with a dilute sodium hydroxide solution

rows: Dilute HCl ya dilute H₂SO₄ ke saath garam
Dilute NaOH mehlool ke saath garam
Seedha azad ethanoic acid deti hai
Sodium ethanoate deti hai; acid ke liye dilute HCl se acidify karein
Nitrogen NH₄Cl ban jati hai
Nitrogen NH₃ gas ban kar nikalti hai

blocks.prompt:
46 What are amides? Why are they called acid amides?
(Amides kya hain? Inhein acid amides kyun kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Amides woh compounds hain jin mein –CO–NH₂ functional group ho, maslan ethanamide CH₃CONH₂. Kyun ke yeh carboxylic acids se banti hain, is liye inhein kabhi acid amides bhi kehte hain.

book_ref.quote: Since they are prepared from carboxylic acids that is why amides are still sometimes called

blocks.prompt:
47 Write the equations for preparing ethanamide and benzamide from acyl chlorides.
(Acyl chlorides se ethanamide aur benzamide banane ki equations likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Acyl chlorides room temperature par ammonia se react karte hain:
CH₃COCl + NH₃ → CH₃CONH₂ + HCl
C₆H₅COCl + NH₃ → C₆H₅CONH₂ + HCl

book_ref.quote: Amides from acyl chlorides and ammonia

blocks.prompt:
48 How is N-phenylethanamide prepared? Give the equation.
(N-phenylethanamide kaise banti hai? Equation dein.)
blocks.explanation:
Ethanoyl chloride ko primary amine phenylamine se room temperature par react kara kar (HCl ke safaid dhuen):
CH₃COCl + C₆H₅NH₂ → CH₃CONHC₆H₅ + HCl

book_ref.quote: Amides from acyl chlorides and primary amines

blocks.prompt:
49 Why is an excess of ammonia or amine used when acyl chlorides are converted into amides?
(Acyl chlorides ko amides mein badalte waqt ammonia ya amine zyada kyun li jati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Banne wali HCl ammonia ya amine ke doosre molecule se salt banati hai (NH₃ + HCl → NH₄⁺Cl⁻; RNH₂ + HCl → RNH₃⁺Cl⁻). Is se kuch reagent zaaya hota hai, is liye reaction mukammal karne ke liye zyada liya jata hai.

book_ref.quote: The HCl produced reacts with another molecule of ammonia or amine to form a salt

blocks.prompt:
50 Why do amides have high melting and boiling points, and why are these lower in N-substituted amides?
(Amides ke melting aur boiling points buland kyun hain, aur N-substituted amides mein kam kyun hain?)
blocks.explanation: Amides apne N–H aur C=O groups se mazboot intermolecular hydrogen bonds banati hain, is liye yeh solid hain (sirf methanamide liquid hai) aur boiling points buland hain. Nitrogen par alkyl groups N–H ki jagah le lete hain, hydrogen bonding ki jagahein kam hoti hain aur melting aur boiling points kam ho jate hain.

book_ref.quote: They have quite high boiling points which is a consequence of strong intermolecular hydrogen bonding

blocks.prompt:
51 Why is the C–N bond in an amide (132 pm) shorter than in an amine (147 pm)?
(Amide ka C–N bond (132 pm) amine (147 pm) se chhota kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Amide mein nitrogen ka lone pair resonance se carbonyl oxygen ki taraf phail jata hai (O=C–NH₂ ↔ ⁻O–C=NH₂⁺). Is se C–N bond mein kuch double bond ki khasiyat aa jati hai, is liye yeh aam C–N single bond se chhota hai.

book_ref.quote: The introduction of double bond character between carbon and nitrogen

blocks.prompt:
52 Compare the basic nature of an amide and an aliphatic amine.
(Amide aur aliphatic amine ki basic khasiyat ka muqabla karein.)
blocks.explanation: Paani mein in ka rawayya aur wajah:

book_ref.quote: Amides are less basic than aliphatic amines

rows: Kam basic
Zyada basic
Paani mein neutral mehlool
Paani mein halka alkaline mehlool (OH⁻ ions)
N ka lone pair resonance se carbonyl oxygen par phail jata hai
N ka lone pair dastyab; alkyl group electrons deta hai

blocks.prompt:
53 Why are amides the least reactive of all acid derivatives?
(Amides tamam acid derivatives mein sab se kam reactive kyun hain?)
blocks.explanation: Nitrogen ka lone pair carbonyl group ki oxygen par phail jata hai. Is se carbonyl carbon ki electrophilic taqat (+δ charge) kam ho jati hai, is liye nucleophiles aahista hamla karte hain; reactions ke liye lambi der garam karna ya acid/base catalysts chahiye.

book_ref.quote: thus decreasing the electrophilic power (+δ charge) of the carbonyl carbon

blocks.prompt:
54 Give the equations for the acid and the base hydrolysis of ethanamide.
(Ethanamide ki acid aur base hydrolysis ki equations dein.)
blocks.explanation:
Acid: CH₃CONH₂ + H₂O + HCl → CH₃COOH + NH₄Cl
Base: CH₃CONH₂ + NaOH → CH₃COONa + NH₃; phir CH₃COONa + HCl → CH₃COOH + NaCl

book_ref.quote: Acid hydrolysis of ethanamide

blocks.prompt:
55 Write the reduction of benzamide with LiAlH₄. Which group is reduced?
(Benzamide ki LiAlH₄ se reduction likhein. Kaun sa group reduce hota hai?)
blocks.explanation:
C₆H₅CONH₂ + 4[H] —(LiAlH₄, dry ether)→ C₆H₅CH₂NH₂ + H₂O
Sirf C=O group CH₂ banta hai; benzene ring waise hi rehti hai aur primary amine banti hai.

book_ref.quote: Amides are reduced to primary amines with lithium tetrahydridoaluminate (III)

blocks.prompt:
56 Why are amino acids amphoteric?
(Amino acids amphoteric kyun hain?)
blocks.explanation: Amino acid mein basic amino group (–NH₂) aur acidic carboxylic acid group (–COOH) dono hote hain, is liye yeh acid aur base dono ki tarah kaam kar sakta hai.

book_ref.quote: This makes amino acids amphoteric, as they can behave as both an acid and a base

blocks.prompt:
57 Why is the dipolar form of glycine called an internal salt? Write its structure.
(Glycine ki dipolar shakal ko internal salt kyun kehte hain? Structure likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
–COOH ka proton usi molecule ke –NH₂ par chala jata hai, dono siron par mukhalif charges aa jate hain, jaise aik hi molecule ke andar salt ban gaya ho:
H₃N⁺–CH₂–COO⁻

book_ref.quote: The dipolar structure is also called the internal salt

blocks.prompt:
58 Write the structures and systematic names of glycine and alanine.
(Glycine aur alanine ke structures aur systematic naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Glycine (aminoethanoic acid), R = H: H₂N–CH₂–COOH
Alanine (2-aminopropanoic acid), R = –CH₃: H₂N–CH(CH₃)–COOH

book_ref.quote: Alanine (2-amino propanoic acid) is an amino acid in which the R group is the methyl group

blocks.prompt:
59 Why is glycine the only α-amino acid that is not chiral?
(Glycine wahid α-amino acid kyun hai jo chiral nahi?)
blocks.explanation: Glycine mein R group hydrogen atom hai, is liye α-carbon par do H atoms hain aur yeh chaar mukhtalif groups se nahi jura. Baqi tamam α-amino acids mein R hydrogen nahi, is liye un ka α-carbon chiral hai.

book_ref.quote: Except glycine all α-amino acids are chiral.

blocks.prompt:
60 Differentiate between essential and non-essential amino acids.
(Essential aur non-essential amino acids mein farq batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Farq yeh hai ke jism inhein bana sakta hai ya nahi:

book_ref.quote: essential (body cannot synthesis)

rows: Jism inhein nahi bana sakta
Jism inhein bana sakta hai
Khurak se lene zaroori hain
Khurak se lena zaroori nahi

blocks.text: 24.6.1 Acidic and Basic Properties of Amino Acids

blocks.prompt:
61 In the zwitter ion of an amino acid, which group is the acidic part and which is the basic part? Give equations.
(Amino acid ke zwitter ion mein kaun sa group acidic hissa aur kaun sa basic hissa hai? Equations dein.)
blocks.explanation:
Acidic hissa –NH₃⁺: H₃N⁺–CH(R)–COO⁻ + H₂O ⇌ H₂N–CH(R)–COO⁻ + H₃O⁺ (pKa ≈ 10)
Basic hissa –COO⁻: H₃N⁺–CH(R)–COO⁻ + H₂O ⇌ H₃N⁺–CH(R)–COOH + OH⁻ (pKb ≈ 12)

book_ref.quote: In fact, the acidic part of the amino acid molecule is –NH₃⁺, group

blocks.prompt:
62 Why are amino acids less acidic than most carboxylic acids?
(Amino acids zyada tar carboxylic acids se kam acidic kyun hain?)
blocks.explanation: Zwitter ion mein acidic hissa –NH₃⁺ group hai, –COOH nahi. RNH₃⁺ RCOOH se kamzor acid hai (pKa ≈ 10), is liye amino acids zyada tar carboxylic acids se kam acidic hain.

book_ref.quote: However, they are less acidic than most carboxylic acids, and are less basic than most amines

blocks.prompt:
63 Which form of an amino acid predominates at (i) low pH (ii) the isoelectric pH (iii) high pH?
(Amino acid ki kaun si shakal ghalib hoti hai: (i) kam pH par (ii) isoelectric pH par (iii) zyada pH par?)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Kam pH: cationic shakal, H₃N⁺–CH(R)–COOH
(ii) Isoelectric pH: dipolar ion, H₃N⁺–CH(R)–COO⁻
(iii) Zyada pH: anionic shakal, H₂N–CH(R)–COO⁻

book_ref.quote: In the aqueous solution, an equilibrium exists between the dipolar ion and a cationic and an anionic form

blocks.prompt:
64 Define the isoelectric point of an amino acid.
(Amino acid ke isoelectric point ki definition likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Isoelectric point (pI) woh khaas pH hai jis par zwitter ion ka concentration sab se zyada hota hai, yani amino acid par koi majmui charge nahi hota. Har amino acid ka apna alag pI hota hai.

book_ref.quote: For each amino acid, there is specific pH at which the concentration of the zwitter ion reaches its maximum value

blocks.text: 24.6.2 Separation of Amino Acids by Electrophoresis

blocks.prompt:
65 What is electrophoresis? On what basis does it separate amino acids?
(Electrophoresis kya hai? Yeh amino acids ko kis buniyaad par alag karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Electrophoresis woh tareeqa hai jis mein amino acid mixture ke qatre do electrodes ke darmiyan buffered mehlool mein rakhe filter paper ya gel par lagaye jate hain. Electric field lagane par amino acids apne charge, yani mukhtalif pI values, ke mutabiq alag ho jate hain.

book_ref.quote: When an electric field is applied, the amino acids separate based on their different pI values

blocks.prompt:
66 In electrophoresis at pH 6.0, predict the direction of movement of amino acids with pI 9.2 and pI 2.9.
(pH 6.0 par electrophoresis mein pI 9.2 aur pI 2.9 wale amino acids kis taraf chalenge?)
blocks.explanation:
pI 9.2 > pH 6.0: zyada tar positive, cathode ki taraf (farq 3.2).
pI 2.9 < pH 6.0: zyada tar negative, anode ki taraf (farq 3.1).

book_ref.quote: The greater the difference between pI and pH, the faster it will migrate (Figure 24.2)

blocks.prompt:
67 Two amino acids with very similar pI values are run in electrophoresis. Which moves more slowly, and why?
(Bohat milte julte pI wale do amino acids electrophoresis mein chalaye jate hain. Kaun aahista chalega aur kyun?)
blocks.explanation: Zyada molecular weight wala amino acid aahista chalega, kyun ke wohi charge zyada mass ko uthata hai (maslan glycine aur leucine ke pI milte julte hain).

book_ref.quote: because the charge has to carry a greater mass

blocks.prompt:
68 Why is ninhydrin used in electrophoresis of amino acids?
(Amino acids ki electrophoresis mein ninhydrin kyun istemal hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Amino acids be-rang hain, is liye un ke spots nazar nahi aate. Ninhydrin locating agent hai: yeh amino acids se react kar ke jamni (purple) product banata hai jis se har spot ki jagah nazar aati hai.

book_ref.quote: Amino acids are colorless, so a detection technique is necessary

blocks.prompt:
69 Why is electrophoresis called an analytical method only?
(Electrophoresis ko sirf analytical (tajziyati) tareeqa kyun kaha jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh amino acids ki bari miqdaar alag nahi kar sakta; sirf mixture mein amino acids ki tadaad maloom karta hai. Poora mixture waqai alag karne ke liye column chromatography jaise tareeqe istemal hote hain.

book_ref.quote: It is used just as an analytical method for determining the number of amino acids in a mixture

blocks.prompt:
70 What is a peptide link? Why is dipeptide formation called a condensation reaction?
(Peptide link kya hai? Dipeptide banne ko condensation reaction kyun kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Peptide link woh amide bond (–CO–NH–) hai jo aik amino acid ke –COOH aur doosre ke –NH₂ ke darmiyan banta hai. Yeh condensation reaction hai kyun ke do molecules jurte waqt aik chhota molecule, paani, nikal jata hai.

book_ref.quote: Note that the shaded area is the amide bond between the two amino acids

blocks.prompt:
71 Write the equation for the formation of the dipeptide from two glycine molecules.
(Do glycine molecules se dipeptide banne ki equation likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
H₂N–CH₂–COOH + H₂N–CH₂–COOH → H₂N–CH₂–CO–NH–CH₂–COOH + H₂O
–CO–NH– group peptide link hai.

book_ref.quote: Formation of a dipeptide and the peptide link

blocks.prompt:
72 Differentiate between a tripeptide and a polypeptide.
(Tripeptide aur polypeptide mein farq batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono amino acids ke condensation products hain:

book_ref.quote: a compound formed from the condensation between a large number of amino acids

rows: Teen amino acids se banta hai
Bohat se amino acids se banta hai
Is mein chand peptide links hote hain
Is mein bohat se peptide links hote hain

blocks.prompt:
73 How many water molecules are eliminated when five amino acids join in a chain to form a pentapeptide?
(Paanch amino acids chain mein jur kar pentapeptide banayein to kitne paani ke molecules nikalte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Har peptide link banne par aik H₂O nikalta hai. Chain mein paanch amino acids 5 – 1 = 4 peptide links se jurte hain, is liye 4 paani ke molecules nikalte hain.

book_ref.quote: The reaction is a condensation reaction, as a small molecule

blocks.prompt:
74 Write the R groups of aspartic acid and lysine. Which one has an extra basic group?
(Aspartic acid aur lysine ke R groups likhein. Kis mein izafi basic group hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Aspartic acid: R = –CH₂–COOH (izafi acidic –COOH).
Lysine: R = –CH₂–(CH₂)₃NH₂ (izafi basic –NH₂). Is liye lysine mein izafi basic group hai.

book_ref.quote: The R groups in the amino acids aspartic acid and lysine are
